facts.text: Graduates from many aviation schools need 1,500 total flight hours, but Rocky Mountain College graduates qualify for the top category requiring only 1,000 hours.

sources.title: Accreditation - RMC - Rocky Mountain College
sources.quote: Due to FAA requirements, graduates from many schools need 1,500 total flight hours, while RMC graduates fall into the top category of schools where graduates only need 1,000 hours.
